Nicknamed "'''the Great Barrier Thief'''" for his defensive and stealing abilities, he was selected eighth overall by the [[New Orleans Pelicans]] in the first round of the [[2022 NBA draft]]. In 2025, Daniels became the first [[Australians|Australian]] to win the [[NBA Most Improved Player]] award. ==Early life and career== Daniels was born on March 17, 2003, in [[Bendigo]], [[Victoria (state)|Victoria]], and started playing basketball at age seven.{{cite web |title=Boomers' phenom will have you shouting "Damn, Daniels!" |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/asiacup/2021/qualifiers/news/boomer-s-phenom-will-have-you-shouting-damn-daniels |publisher=[[FIBA]] |access-date=21 June 2021 |date=21 February 2021}} He attended [[Bendigo South East College]].{{cite web |title=Dyson Daniels |url=https://www.olympics.com.au/olympians/dyson-daniels/ |website=Australian Olympic Committee |access-date=11 July 2024}} Daniels signed with the [[Bendigo Braves]], his father's former team, of the [[NBL1]] for the [[2019 NBL1 season|2019 season]].{{cite web |last=Iles |first=Kieran |title=Dyson Daniels keen to forge his own identity with Bendigo Braves |url=https://www.bendigoadvertiser.com.au/story/5925221/dyson-daniels-keen-to-forge-his-own-identity-with-bendigo-braves/ |website=[[Bendigo Advertiser]] |access-date=21 June 2021 |date=26 February 2019}} Later that year, Daniels joined the [[NBA Global Academy]], a training center at the [[Australian Institute of Sport]] in [[Canberra]].{{cite web |last=Garlepp |first=Josh |title=Dyson Daniels is the NBA Global Academy's latest star, with an admirable goal in mind |url=https://www.foxsports.com.au/basketball/dyson-daniels-is-the-nba-global-academys-newest-star-with-an-admirable-goal-in-mind/news-story/9a1338f014f554819afa80af41cc01f0 |website=[[Fox Sports (Australia)|Fox Sports]] |access-date=21 June 2021 |date=1 March 2020}} He helped Victoria win a silver medal at the 2021 Australian Under-20 Championships.{{cite web |last=Bourke |first=Adam |title=Daniels dominates for Victoria at national championships |url=https://www.bendigoadvertiser.com.au/story/7243777/daniels-dominates-for-victoria-at-national-championships/ |website=[[Bendigo Advertiser]] |access-date=21 June 2021 |date=8 May 2021}} Along with basketball, Daniels was a talented [[Australian rules football]]er in his younger years and represented his home state of [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] at several national football championships{{cite web |last=Tuckerman |first=Raelee |title=Dyson sports Big V |url=https://www.bendigoadvertiser.com.au/story/3122974/dyson-sports-big-v/ |website=[[Bendigo Advertiser]] |access-date=13 January 2022 |date=3 June 2015}} before giving up the sport to focus solely on basketball. ==Professional career== ===NBA G League Ignite (2021–2022)=== On 21 June 2021, Daniels signed with the [[NBA G League Ignite]], a developmental team affiliated with the [[NBA G League]].{{cite web |title=International Standout Dyson Daniels Signs With NBA G League Ignite |url=https://gleague.nba.com/news/international-standout-dyson-daniels-signs-with-nba-g-league-ignite/ |publisher=[[NBA G League]] |access-date=21 June 2021 |date=21 June 2021}} He turned down offers from several college programs and the [[National Basketball League (Australia)|National Basketball League]] Next Stars program.{{cite web |last=Givony |first=Jonathan |date=20 June 2021 |title=NBA's G League Ignite sign first highly touted international prospect in Australia's Dyson Daniels |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/31674738 |access-date=21 June 2021 |website=[[ESPN]]}} Daniels competed in the [[Rising Stars Challenge]] at [[2022 NBA All-Star Game#All-Star Weekend|2022 NBA All-Star Weekend]] and helped his team win the title. In 26 games in the G League, he averaged 12 points, 7.1 rebounds, 5.1 assists and two steals per game. On 16 April 2022, Daniels declared for the [[2022 NBA draft]].{{Cite web |date=16 April 2022 |title=Australian guard Dyson Daniels, the No. 10 prospect in the ESPN 100, to enter the 2022 NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/33751931 |access-date=16 April 2022 |website=ESPN}} ===New Orleans Pelicans (2022–2024)=== Daniels was selected with the eighth overall pick in the [[2022 NBA draft]] by the [[New Orleans Pelicans]].{{cite web|title=New Orleans Pelicans select Dyson Daniels with 8th pick in 2022 NBA Draft|url=https://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/dyson-daniels-2022-nba-draft-new-orleans-pelicans-pick-8|website=NBA.com|date=23 June 2022|access-date=14 July 2022}} Daniels joined the Pelicans' [[2022 NBA Summer League]] roster. However, Daniels suffered a right-ankle sprain in the second quarter in the Pelicans' Summer League opener against the [[Portland Trail Blazers]], forcing Daniels to be ruled as out for the rest of the Summer League.{{cite web|first=Kyle T.|last=Mosley|title=Pelicans Dyson Daniels Injured in His First Summer League Game|url=https://www.si.com/nba/pelicans/news/dyson-daniels-injured-summer-league|website=SI.com|date=10 July 2022 |access-date=14 July 2022}} On 9 July 2022, Daniels signed a rookie-scale contract with the Pelicans.{{cite web |date=9 July 2022 |title=Pelicans sign Dyson Daniels |url=https://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/dyson-daniels-signed-new-orleans-pelicans-roster |access-date=14 July 2022 |website=NBA.com}} ===Atlanta Hawks (2024–present)=== ====2024–25 season==== On 6 July 2024, Daniels, [[E. J. Liddell]], [[Larry Nance Jr.]], and [[Cody Zeller]] (via sign-and-trade), a 2025 first-round pick (via Lakers), and a conditional 2027 first-round pick were traded to the [[Atlanta Hawks]] in exchange for [[Dejounte Murray]].{{cite web|title=Hawks Acquire Dyson Daniels, E.J. Liddell, Larry Nance Jr., Cody Zeller, and 2 Future First-Round Draft Picks|url=https://www.nba.com/hawks/news/hawks-acquire-dyson-daniels-e-j-liddell-larry-nance-jr-cody-zeller-and-2-future-first-round-draft-picks|website=NBA.com|date=6 July 2024|access-date=6 July 2024}} On 8 November, Daniels put up seven steals in a 122–121 loss to the [[Detroit Pistons]].{{cite web |date=9 November 2024 |title=Hawks' Trae Young, Bulls' Nikola Vucevic look to get teams on track |url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/basketball/hawks-trae-young-bulls-nikola-vucevic-look-get-teams-track-2024-11-09 |access-date=10 November 2024 |website=Reuters |agency=Field Level Media}} On 15 November, Daniels became the first player since [[Michael Jordan]] in the [[1989–90 NBA season|1989–90 season]] to record 15-plus points and five-plus steals in four consecutive NBA games{{cite web |date=16 November 2024 |title=Dyson Daniels equals Michael Jordan record as the Australian's stunning start to the NBA season continues |url=https://www.abc.net.au/news/2024-11-16/nba-dyson-daniels-matches-michael-jordan-record/104610158 |access-date=9 January 2025 |website=abc.net.au}} and the first player since [[Alvin Robertson]] to record at least six steals in four consecutive NBA games.{{cite news |last=McMurtry |first=Andrew |date=19 November 2024 |title='No notes': Dyson Daniels' nickname takes over NBA after clutch scenes |url=https://www.couriermail.com.au/sport/basketball/nba/no-notes-dyson-daniels-nickname-takes-over-nba-after-clutch-scenes/news-story/37b686fc8727dc1c279b4a687b48f37c |access-date=14 December 2024 |work=couriermail.com.au}} On 23 December, Daniels recorded a career-high eight steals against the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]].{{Cite news |last=McKern |first=James |date=2024-12-24 |title=Dyson Daniels rewrites record books with historic feat |url=https://www.news.com.au/sport/basketball/nba/dyson-daniels-rewrites-atlanta-hawks-record-books-with-absurd-display/news-story/b116a341e73b356eb76b681c89c49f4f?amp |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241224065133/https://www.news.com.au/sport/basketball/nba/dyson-daniels-rewrites-atlanta-hawks-record-books-with-absurd-display/news-story/b116a341e73b356eb76b681c89c49f4f?amp |archive-date=24 December 2024 |access-date=2025-01-08 |work=news.com.au |language=en-AU }} Daniels finished the [[2024-25 NBA season|2024–25 season]] leading the NBA with an average of 3.01 steals per game, totaling 202 steals. This achievement made him the youngest player in NBA history to record 200 steals in a single season, surpassing Magic Johnson's previous record by 236 days.{{cite news |date=24 March 2025 |title=Dyson Daniels passes Magic Johnson to break NBA record |url=https://www.news.com.au/sport/basketball/dyson-daniels-has-gone-past-magic-johnson-as-the-youngest-player-to-get-200-steals-in-an-nba-season/news-story/4dd9ea2f0c6066728ccfd2ca730386e3 |access-date=16 May 2025 |publisher=News.com.au |agency=NewsWire}} Daniels' defensive impact extended beyond steals; he also led the NBA in deflections (366) and ranked among the top players in combined steals and blocks ("stocks") with 229.{{cite news |last=Ahmed |first=Mohamud |date=14 May 2025 |title=Dyson Daniels likened to Jordan and Wembanyama |url=https://talksport.com/basketball/3018327/dyson-daniels-michael-jordan-victor-wembanyama-nba-atlanta-hawks/ |access-date=16 May 2025 |publisher=TalkSport}} On 30 April, 2025, Daniels became the first Australian to win the [[NBA Most Improved Player]] award, after becoming the first player since Alvin Robertson in [[1990–91 NBA season|1990–91]] to average three steals per game.{{Cite web |date=2025-04-30 |title=Hawks' Dyson Daniels named 2024-25 Kia NBA Most Improved Player |url=https://www.nba.com/news/kia-most-improved-player-2024-25-dyson-daniels |access-date=2025-04-30 |website=NBA.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Dyson Daniels Named Kia Most Improved Player |url=https://www.nba.com/hawks/news/dyson-daniels-named-kia-most-improved-player |access-date=2025-05-01 |website=NBA.com |language=en}} Daniels also finished as the runner-up in the 2025 NBA Defensive Player of the Year voting, earning 25 first-place votes and 197 total points. He was edged out by [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] forward-center [[Evan Mobley]], who received 35 first-place votes and 285 total points.{{cite news |last=Jackson |first=Andrew |date=25 April 2025 |title=NBA 2025: Dyson Daniels snubbed for DPOY |url=https://www.foxsports.com.au/basketball/nba/nba-2025-dyson-daniels-snubbed-of-defensive-player-of-the-year-as-evan-mobley-wins-votes-reaction/news-story/c498e04b9aafa300c429961a00f2f232 |access-date=16 May 2025 |publisher=Fox Sports Australia}} ====2025–26 season==== On October 20, 2025, Daniels and the Hawks agreed to a four-year, $100 million contract extension.{{cite web |last=Charania |first=Shams |author-link=Shams Charania |date=2025-10-20 |title=Hawks guard Daniels agrees to 4-year, $100M deal |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/46661563/hawks-dyson-daniels-agrees-four-year-100m-extension |access-date=2025-12-08 |website=ESPN.com}} The Hawks finished the season with a 46–36 record, clinching the sixth seed in the Eastern Conference and a playoff berth. Daniels was named to the [[NBA All-Defensive Team|NBA All-Defensive Second Team]].{{cite web |url=https://www.nba.com/news/2025-26-all-defensive-teams-announced |title=Kia All-Defensive Teams, NBA Social Justice Champion revealed live on Peacock |website=NBA.com |date=May 22, 2026}} The Hawks faced the [[2025–26 New York Knicks season|New York Knicks]] during their first-round playoff series. On April 18, Daniels made his playoff debut for the Hawks, recording four points, nine rebounds, 11 assists, and three steals in a 113–102 Game 1 loss.{{Cite web |title=BRUNSON AND TOWNS LEAD THE KNICKS PAST THE HAWKS 113-102 IN GAME 1 OF THEIR SERIES |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0042500121 |access-date=May 1, 2026 |website=NBA.com}} On April 28, he scored a playoff career-high 17 points, alongside five assists, in a 126–97 Game 5 loss.{{Cite web |title=JALEN BRUNSON SCORES 39 POINTS AND THE KNICKS ROUT THE HAWKS 126-97 FOR A 3-2 SERIES LEAD |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0042500125 |access-date=May 1, 2026 |website=NBA.com}} The Hawks wound up losing the series in six games. ==National team career== Daniels represented Australia at the 2018 [[FIBA Oceania]] Under-15 Championship in Papua New Guinea. He averaged 8.3 points, 3.7 rebounds and 2.7 assists per game, helping his team win the gold medal.{{cite web |title=Dyson Daniels (AUS)'s profile – FIBA U15 Oceania Championship 2018 |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/oceania/u15/2018/player/Dyson-Daniels |publisher=[[FIBA]] |access-date=21 June 2021}} On 20 February 2021, a 17-year-old Daniels made his debut for the [[Australia men's national basketball team|Australian senior national team]] at [[2021 FIBA Asia Cup qualification|FIBA Asia Cup qualification]].{{cite web |last=Ward |first=Roy |title='He's kind of unique, a throwback': Dyson Daniels follows in Ben Simmons' footsteps in making Boomers debut |url=https://www.smh.com.au/sport/basketball/he-s-kind-of-unique-a-throwback-dyson-daniels-follows-in-ben-simmons-footsteps-in-making-boomers-debut-20210219-p573y2.html |website=[[The Sydney Morning Herald]] |access-date=21 June 2021 |date=19 February 2021}} He recorded 23 points, six steals and four assists in an 81–52 win over [[New Zealand men's national basketball team|New Zealand]].{{cite web |last=Kidane |first=Benyam |title=Dyson Daniels leads young Aussie Boomers to impressive win over New Zealand in FIBA Asia Cup qualifier |url=https://www.sportingnews.com/au/nba/news/dyson-daniels-leads-young-australian-boomers-win-over-new-zealand-fiba-asia-cup-qualifier/17xvq05d39hm81n86tpzy70514 |website=[[Sporting News]] |access-date=21 June 2021 |date=20 February 2021}} He helped Australia to beat France in a preparation game for the 2024 Olympic Games, scoring a reverse layup on the buzzer to win the game.{{Cite web |date=2024-07-21 |title=Epic Boomers win completes near-perfect Paris preparation |url=https://www.nine.com.au/sport/olympics/paris-2024-australia-boomers-beat-france-basketball-warm-up-game-dyson-daniels-patty-mills-20240722-p5jvfc.html |access-date=2024-08-06 |website=Nine Ricky Daniels, is from the United States and played [[college basketball]] for the [[NC State Wolfpack men's basketball|NC State Wolfpack]] before embarking on a professional career. He was a two-time [[South East Australian Basketball League]] MVP with the [[Bendigo Braves]], and his number was retired by the team.{{cite web |date=22 February 2019 |title=Dyson Daniels to emulate his father, Ricky, and play for Braves |url=https://www.bendigoadvertiser.com.au/story/5920207/like-father-like-son-dyson-daniels-to-play-for-braves-senior-team/ |url-access=subscription |url=https://www.prospectiveinsight.com/post/dyson-daniels |website=Pro Insight |access-date=21 June 2021 |date=30 October 2020}} His younger brother, [[Dash Daniels|Dash]], is an NBL Next Star{{Cite
